name: The Sum of the k-th Powers
description: There are well-known formulas: , , . Also mathematicians found similar formulas for higher degrees. Find the value of the sum modulo 10 9 + 7 (so you should find the remainder after dividing the answer by the value 10 9 + 7 ).
input_specification: The only line contains two integers n , k ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 9 , 0 ≤ k ≤ 10 6 ).
output_specification: Print the only integer a — the remainder after dividing the value of the sum by the value 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
